Downloads every public area-level source from its publisher and prepares it for linkage. It uses no USRDS data.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/download_public_data.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/download_public_data.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/functions.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/download_public_data.R")
```

## Downloads

Files are cached in the gitignored `data-raw/` folder, so later runs do not download again. The original analysis read copies of these files from the analyst's computer; here each comes from a published URL (see [`references.bib`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/references.bib)).

```{r}
#| label: download-public-files
#| eval: false
```

## ZIP code to HSA

One Dartmouth crosswalk per year, 2011 to 2019. The 2018 and 2019 files are published as zipped CSV rather than Excel; the original reader only looked for Excel files. Each ZIP code and year must appear once.

```{r}
#| label: read-hsa-crosswalk
#| eval: false
```

## American Community Survey

ZCTA estimates from the 5-year subject table S0601 for each study year. Every year's variable labels are checked first. As in the original code, the ZCTA code is used as the ZIP code; the original's separate ZIP-to-ZCTA crosswalk was counted in its CONSORT table but never used to filter, so it is dropped here.

```{r}
#| label: download-acs
#| eval: false
```

## HSA population

The denominator of the exposure: the sum of ZCTA populations over the ZIP codes in each HSA that year.
